2822:      "body": "**FGA picSharp rewire LANDED (run 0008): route-(b) conventions + two standing caveats.**\n\nState after the rewire (`Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean`, **4 real `sorry`s**, all TRUE statements \u2014 Ground-verified run 0008 reconcile):\n\n- `picSharp C := PicSharp.relPresheaf C \u22d9 forget AddCommGrpCat` (`Type (u+1)`-valued, REAL). `Scheme.HasRationalPoint C` = Nonempty section subtype of `C.hom`; the ONE genuine FGA sorry is `instHasPicScheme [HasRationalPoint C]`. The other three are typed-sorry carriers: `PicSchemeLocallyOfFiniteType` (Kleiman \u00a74 `th:main`(1), true under the rational point) and the pre-existing Quot-blocked `HasDivFunctor` / `HasAbelMap`.\n- `instPicSharpRepresentable` proved by `choose_spec`; `groupSchemeStructure : CommGrpObj (PicScheme C)` proved via `CommGrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` + a `Multiplicative.ofAdd` NatIso (`picSharpCommGrpForgetIso`, naturality is `rfl` \u2014 no defeq walls anywhere in this file).\n- Consumers: quantify over `[HasPicScheme C]` (synthesized from `[HasRationalPoint C]`) \u2014 `degree`/`kPoints_iff_kerDegree` in `IdentityComponent.lean` now carry it. `Pic0Scheme C := GroupScheme.IdentityComponent (PicScheme C)` is now a real def (axiom-clean), gated on `PicSchemeLocallyOfFiniteType`.\n\n**Caveat 1 \u2014 pointless curves:** `JacobianWitness` (`Jacobian.lean`) requires the abelian variety $J$ to exist UNconditionally, but route (b) only builds `PicScheme` for pointed $C$. For a genus-$\\ge 1$ curve without a rational point the eventual `picardJacobianWitness` proof needs Galois/\u00e9tale descent from a finite extension where $C$ gains a point (or a pointed restatement of the north star). Not blocking anything now \u2014 record before anyone tries to close `picardJacobianWitness` directly.\n\n**Caveat 2 \u2014 `smoothProperQuotient` statement is WEAKER than Kleiman lm:qt and unprovable as stated:** Mathlib v4.31 has NO quasi-projectivity vocabulary, so hypothesis (2) of lm:qt is missing from the Lean statement; without it the statement is FALSE (Hironaka-type free \u2124/2 action on a smooth proper non-projective 3-fold: smooth proper equivalence relation, \u00e9tale-quotient sheaf a non-scheme algebraic space). The former GLOBAL `instHasSmoothProperQuotient \u27e8sorry\u27e9` (every presheaf representable!) was deleted this run (Ground-confirmed gone); the class is a use-site hypothesis only. Do NOT reintroduce a global instance, and do NOT try to prove the theorem as stated.",

4203:      "body": "[persistent] [persistent] REPRESENTABILITY PUSH, 2026-07-29 \u2014 the claim/lane protocol that makes 10 free-objective lanes not collide.\n\nWHY THIS EXISTS. This round replaces prescriptive per-leaf tasks with FIVE lanes per project: one REVIEWER and four PROVERS ranked p1..p4. The provers each pick their own target. That only works if claiming is explicit and public. This item is the claiming mechanism. Read it before your first edit.\n\nTHE FIVE LANES PER PROJECT\n- `review-ajc` / `review-ajcr` \u2014 reviewer. Read-mostly. Finds defects of ROUTE and ORGANISATION, not of individual proofs; may propose refactors and file tasks-as-proposals for the provers. Does not race provers for proof work.\n- `ajc-p1` / `ajcr-p1` \u2014 takes the MOST important open representability item.\n- `-p2`, `-p3`, `-p4` \u2014 2nd, 3rd, 4th most important, where \"important\" is measured against the project's representability headline, not by ease.\n\nCLAIMING \u2014 do this BEFORE you start proving, not after.\n 1. `horizon roadmap list --focus <your project's w4-rep / picrep subtree>` and read the reviewer's open notes.\n 2. Pick your item. Check no other lane owns it: an item with `--owner` set to another lane IS CLAIMED. Do not take it, even if you think you would be faster.\n 3. Claim it: `horizon roadmap set <id> --owner <your-task-id> --status active`. If your target is not yet a roadmap item, `roadmap add` it under the right parent first, then claim it.\n 4. Announce: one `horizon inbox add --kind info --to horizon --body \"CLAIM <lane>: <roadmap id> \u2014 <one line on what discharging it buys>\"`.\n 5. Release on exit: if you did NOT finish, `roadmap set <id> --owner ''` and leave a one-line inbox note saying where you stopped and what the next lane should NOT re-derive. An item left owned by a dead lane is worse than an unclaimed one.\n\nRANK IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A FENCE. If p1's item turns out to be blocked on p3's, say so in the inbox and swap \u2014 rank exists so four lanes do not all converge on the same top item, not to stop you working on the right thing. p1 has first refusal on any contested item.\n\nYOU MAY PROPOSE WORK TO THE OTHER LANES. Direct-message with `horizon inbox add --kind hint --to task:<lane-id> --body \"\u2026\"`. A good proposal names the declaration, the file, and why it is worth more than what that lane currently holds. You may NOT reassign another lane's claimed item, and you may NOT create new horizon runs or tasks for teams outside your own (`horizon permissions` is false on both counts \u2014 propose to the human instead).\n\nSTANDING BINDING DECISIONS you must not relitigate: `I-0491` (AJC: no rational-point binder on the headline; `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` is FALSE and must be deleted, never proved) and `I-0492` (AJCR: `DivFamZar` widens to arbitrary affine opens; do NOT build the GL_2/Aut(P1) route). Read both.\n\nWHAT COUNTS AS PROGRESS, given the 2026-07-29 audit. That audit found 99 of 101 sampled representability claims refuted: 67 sorry-reachable, 17 VACUOUS, 12 hypothesis-shifted. So the bar is explicit:\n- A discharged obligation must be sorry-free AND its hypotheses must be inhabitable. Before you claim a gate closed, exhibit a witness for every antecedent, or say plainly which antecedent is still undischarged.\n- Do NOT add a class, structure field, or hypothesis whose statement does not mention the object it is supposedly about. `HasDivFunctor` is the cautionary case: its field asserted only that a presheaf category is nonempty, `C` did not occur, and it was advertised as the existence of the relative divisor functor. That is a vacuity, and it survived because nobody read the statement.\n- Do NOT discharge an obligation by projecting the hypothesis you assumed (`choose_spec.1` of your own binder). That is `P \u2192 P`.\n- A green `lake build` is not evidence a statement is non-vacuous. Check imports are current before believing a `lean_multi_attempt` success.\n\nCOMMIT DISCIPLINE. This is ONE shared ledger branch with 10 writers. Another lane's integrate sweep can commit your half-written file before you have measured it once. Write risky proofs as explicit `sorry` first, measure, then fill. Stage explicit files, never `add -A`.",

Of the 24 `active` rows, 14 have children and 10 are leaves. Every cone is unowned and is active because its subtree is in progress: AJC.jacobian (8 children), AJC.picrep (19), AJCR.w4-rep.datum (21), AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate (21), and ten more. Verified: with R = ULift PUnit, all seven fields of IsCertified n close for every n (rankAtStalk_glued := fun p => (IsEmpty.false p).elim), giving DivFamZar C R pi n inhabited at arbitrary n. EXIT=0. The intended fact IS true and should be stated with its hypothesis: over a NONTRIVIAL R, trivAdapt satisfies six of the seven clauses at every n and fails rankAtStalk_glued at every n > 0 -- I verified that refutation too (Nontrivial R gives a prime, rankAtStalk of a subsingleton is 0, contradicting = 1). 1	/-

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveMap
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveSite
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartCoverageDegreeStep2
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Target identities for admissible Abel lifts
    12	
    13	This module packages the class-level equalities used after an affine Picard class has been
    14	honestified and a widened divisor family has been constructed.  It identifies the honest
    15	twisted Cech class with the chart twist, computes its degree after every field-valued base
    16	change, and turns equality of widened Picard classes into the literal Abel and chart-value
    17	equalities required by the local lifting argument.
    18	
    19	No representability, quotient, atlas, or local-surjectivity assertion is made here.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    36	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/- The degree API is stated on `relCurve`; install the product-spelled base-change instances
    41	under that alias for every field used below. -/
    42	noncomputable local instance instIsIntegralRelCurveTarget
    43	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
    44	  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    45	
    46	noncomputable local instance instSmoothRelCurveTarget
    47	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    48	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
    49	  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    50	
    51	noncomputable local instance instQuasiCompactRelCurveTarget
    52	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    53	    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
    54	  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    55	
    56	noncomputable local instance instFiniteH0RelCurveTarget
    57	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    58	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    59	  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
    60	
    61	noncomputable local instance instFiniteH1RelCurveTarget
    62	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    63	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    64	  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
    65	
    66	/-! ## The honest twisted target -/
    67	
    68	/-- If a degree-zero target becomes the honest Cech class `c` on an affine test, then its
    69	chart twist is the unit image of `c` multiplied by the base-changed collapsed twist class. -/
    70	theorem relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist
    71	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
    72	    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    73	    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
    74	    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
    75	    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
    76	      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
    77	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) :
    78	    relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B)
    79	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)
    80	          (c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B)
    81	            (chartTwistClass C m Z))) =
    82	      chartTwist C m Z (overSpec k B)
    83	        (pic0Map C g lam : picEt C (overSpec k B)) := by
    84	  apply (picEtAffineEquiv C B).injective
    85	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt,
    86	    chartTwist_eq_mul_thetaFamily_chartTwistClass]
    87	  change PicEtAff.unit C B
    88	      (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)
    89	        (c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z))) =
    90	    picEtAffineEquiv C B
    91	      (picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) *
    92	        thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C m Z) (overSpec k B))
    93	  rw [map_mul (picEtAffineEquiv C B), hpic,
    94	    picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt,
    95	    picEtAffineEquiv_thetaFamily_eq_unit_relPicMk]
    96	  exact map_mul ((PicEtAff.unit C B).comp (relPicMk C (overSpec k B))) _ _
    97	
    98	/-- Datum-facing orientation of `relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist`: a datum presenting
    99	the twisted class honestly presents the chart twist of the restricted target. -/
   100	theorem chartTwist_picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_cechPicClass
   101	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
   102	    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   103	    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
   104	    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
   105	    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
   106	      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
   107	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
   108	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   109	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   110	    (hD : D.cechPicClass =
   111	      c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z)) :
   112	    chartTwist C m Z (overSpec k B) (picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T)) =
   113	      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B)
   114	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) D.cechPicClass) := by
   115	  rw [hD]
   116	  exact (relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist lam g c hpic m Z).symm
   117	
   118	/-! ## Uniform degree of the twisted target -/
   119	
   120	variable {n : ℕ}
   121	
   122	/-- The honest twisted class has the chart parameter as its degree after every field-valued
   123	base change of the affine test. -/
   124	theorem classDeg_twistedClass_eq
   125	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
   126	    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   127	    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
   128	    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
   129	    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
   130	      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
   131	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   132	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z =
   133	      (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   134	    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra B K]
   135	    [IsScalarTower k B K] :
   136	    classDeg K (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B K)
   137	      (c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B)
   138	        (chartTwistClass C m Z))) = (n : ℤ) := by
   139	  let t : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k B :=
   140	    Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B K)
   141	  have h := congrArg
   142	    (fun mu : picEt C (overSpec k B) ⇒ degAt mu t)
   143	    (relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist lam g c hpic m Z)
   144	  rw [degAt_relPicToPicEt, relPicMap_mk, relPicDeg_relPicMk,
   145	    degAt_chartTwist m Z (pic0Map C g lam).2 t] at h
   146	  have ht : (C ◁ t).left = relCurveMap C B K := by
   147	    refine congrArg (fun q : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k B ⇒ (C ◁ q).left) ?_
   148	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   149	  rw [ht] at h
   150	  calc
   151	    _ = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) -
   152	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z := h
   153	    _ = (n : ℤ) := by rw [hdeg]; ring
   154	
   155	/-- Any Cech class identified with the honest twisted class has constant field degree equal to
   156	the chart parameter.  This is the form consumed by datum and local-equation producers. -/
   157	theorem classDeg_eq_of_eq_twistedClass
   158	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
   159	    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   160	    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
   161	    (c d : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
   162	    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
   163	      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
   164	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   165	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z =
   166	      (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   167	    (hd : d = c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B)
   168	      (chartTwistClass C m Z))
   169	    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra B K]
   170	    [IsScalarTower k B K] :
   171	    classDeg K (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B K) d) = (n : ℤ) := by
   172	  rw [hd]
   173	  exact classDeg_twistedClass_eq lam g c hpic m Z hdeg K
   174	
   175	/-! ## Widened Abel and chart-value consequences -/
   176	
   177	/-- A widened family whose Picard class is the honest twisted target has Abel value equal to
   178	the chart twist of the restricted degree-zero target. -/
   179	theorem abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist_of_picClass_eq
   180	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
   181	    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   182	    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
   183	    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
   184	    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
   185	      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
   186	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   187	    (F : DivFamZarAff C B n)
   188	    (hF : F.picClass =
   189	      c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z)) :
   190	    abelDivAff' C n (overSpec k B)
   191	        ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n B).symm F) =
   192	      chartTwist C m Z (overSpec k B)
   193	        (pic0Map C g lam : picEt C (overSpec k B)) := by
   194	  calc
   195	    abelDivAff' C n (overSpec k B)
   196	        ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n B).symm F) =
   197	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B)
   198	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) F.picClass) := by
   199	      apply (picEtAffineEquiv C B).injective
   200	      rw [picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff'_affineEquiv_symm F,
   201	        abelDivAffPlus, picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt]
   202	    _ = relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B)
   203	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)
   204	            (c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B)
   205	              (chartTwistClass C m Z))) := by rw [hF]
   206	    _ = chartTwist C m Z (overSpec k B)
   207	          (pic0Map C g lam : picEt C (overSpec k B)) :=
   208	      relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist lam g c hpic m Z
   209	
   210	/-- The chart transformation sends a widened family with the honest twisted Picard class to
   211	the restricted degree-zero target itself. -/
   212	theorem chartValueAffTrans_app_eq_of_picClass_eq
   213	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
   214	    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   215	    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
   216	    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
   217	    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
   218	      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
   219	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   220	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z =
   221	      (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   222	    (F : DivFamZarAff C B n)
   223	    (hF : F.picClass =
   224	      c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z)) :
   225	    (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (overSpec k B))
   226	        ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n B).symm F) =
   227	      pic0Map C g lam := by
   228	  exact chartValueAffTrans_app_eq_of_abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist
   229	    m Z hdeg _ _
   230	      (abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist_of_picClass_eq lam g c hpic m Z F hF)
   231	
   232	end
   233	
   234	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10

    12	constructed on an affine test. It exposes the chart datum chosen inside the admissible map,
    13	computes a represented point under the Sigma-extended Abel transformation, identifies the
    14	affine Abel value after the vehicle collapse, and packages the final cancellation of the
    15	fixed chart twists.
    16	
    17	No quotient, atlas, or representability conclusion is asserted here.
    18	-/

    25	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite

    29	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

    33	/-- A sieve on a scheme is etale-covering if its pullback to every member of the canonical

    35	theorem mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine {T : Scheme.{u}} (S : Sieve T)
    36	    (h : ∀ (j : T.affineCover.I₀), S.pullback (T.affineCover.f j) ∈
    37	      Scheme.etaleTopology (T.affineCover.X j)) :
    38	    S ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    39	  have hcov : (Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows T.affineCover.X T.affineCover.f))
    40	      ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    41	    apply Scheme.zariskiTopology_le_etaleTopology
    42	    exact Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff.mpr
    43	      ⟨T.affineCover, Sieve.le_generate _⟩
    44	  refine Scheme.etaleTopology.transitive hcov S ?_
    45	  rintro Y g ⟨V, a, b, ⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
    46	  rw [Sieve.pullback_comp]
    47	  exact Scheme.etaleTopology.pullback_stable a (h j)

    57	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology f where

    59	    apply mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine
    60	    intro j
    61	    rw [Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve]

    66	    exact hcover i

    70	/-- The spectrum of the carrier of an algebraic etale cover is a singleton etale cover of

    72	noncomputable def etaleSchemeCover {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    73	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    74	    (Spec (.of A)).Cover (Scheme.precoverage @Etale) :=
    75	  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers PUnit (fun _ => Spec (.of E.Carrier))
    76	    (fun _ => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
    77	    (fun x => by
    78	      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := E.comap_surjective x
    79	      exact ⟨PUnit.unit, y, hy⟩)
    80	    (fun _ => by
    81	      rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]

    88	/-- `mapAlg` agrees with the instance-based affine restriction map when the underlying ring

    90	theorem mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap
    91	    {k A B : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B]
    92	    [Algebra k B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
    93	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
    94	    (hphi : phi.toRingHom = algebraMap A B) (a : PicEtAff C A) :
    95	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C phi a = PicEtAff.map C B a := by
    96	  have hAlg : phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra = (inferInstance : Algebra A B) :=
    97	    Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => by
    98	      change phi r = algebraMap A B r
    99	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hphi r
   100	  unfold PicEtAff.mapAlg
   101	  subst hAlg
   102	  rfl

   104	/-- Restricting an affine PicEt presentation along the map to its own cover carrier produces
   105	the honest class represented by its descent datum. -/
   106	theorem mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self
   107	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   108	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   109	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E) :
   110	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   111	        (PicEtAff.mk C E x)
   112	      = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier
   113	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   114	  rw [mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C _ rfl]
   115	  exact PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self C E x

   123	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   124	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))

   134	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_naturality, h,

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.affineOpens)
variable (E : Algebra.EtaleCover Γ(T.left, U.1))
variable (S : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier → Type u)
variable [∀ p, CommRing (S p)] [∀ p, Algebra E.Carrier (S p)]
variable [∀ p, Algebra.Etale E.Carrier (S p)]

/-- The over-category morphism underlying the member indexed by `p` of the
pointwise prime-lift cover. -/
noncomputable def etalePrimeLiftOverHom
    [∀ p, Algebra k (S p)] [∀ p, IsScalarTower k E.Carrier (S p)]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) :
    overSpec k (S p) ⟶ T :=
  Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E.Carrier (S p)) ≫
    Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier) ≫
      Over.fromSpecAffine T U

/-- Etale spectra carrying chosen lifts of all primes of a singleton etale
presentation form an etale cover of the original affine-open test object.

The hypothesis `hU` is the only place affineness of the target is used: it says
that the chosen affine open is the whole target. -/
noncomputable def etalePrimeLiftCover (hU : U.1 = ⊤)
    (q : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier, PrimeSpectrum (S p))
    (hq : ∀ p, PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p) = p) :
    T.left.Cover (Scheme.precoverage @Etale) :=
  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers (PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier)
    (fun p ↦ Spec (.of (S p)))
    (fun p ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier)) ≫
          (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left)
    (fun x ↦ by
      have hx : x ∈ Set.range U.2.fromSpec.base := by
        rw [U.2.range_fromSpec, hU]
        trivial
      obtain ⟨xA, hxA⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := E.comap_surjective xA
      refine ⟨p, q p, ?_⟩
      change U.2.fromSpec.base
          (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier)
            (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p))) = x
      rw [hq p, hp]
      exact hxA)
    (fun p ↦ by
      haveI : Etale
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)))) := by
        rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
        exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
      haveI : Etale
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier))) := by
        rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
        exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left :=
        U.2.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec
      change Etale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p))) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier)) ≫
            (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left)
      exact MorphismProperty.comp_mem @Etale _ _ inferInstance
        (MorphismProperty.comp_mem @Etale _ _ inferInstance
          (HasRingHomProperty.of_isOpenImmersion
            RingHom.Etale.containsIdentities)))

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

/-- Every member morphism of `etalePrimeLiftCover` is definitionally the left
leg of the corresponding over-category composite. -/
@[simp]
theorem etalePrimeLiftCover_f (hU : U.1 = ⊤)
    [∀ p, Algebra k (S p)] [∀ p, IsScalarTower k E.Carrier (S p)]
    (q : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier, PrimeSpectrum (S p))
    (hq : ∀ p, PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p) = p)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) :
    (etalePrimeLiftCover T U E S hU q hq).f p =
      (etalePrimeLiftOverHom T U E S p).left :=
  rfl

end

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveMap
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveSite
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartCoverageDegreeStep2

/-!
# Target identities for admissible Abel lifts

This module packages the class-level equalities used after an affine Picard class has been
honestified and a widened divisor family has been constructed.  It identifies the honest
twisted Cech class with the chart twist, computes its degree after every field-valued base
change, and turns equality of widened Picard classes into the literal Abel and chart-value
equalities required by the local lifting argument.

No representability, quotient, atlas, or local-surjectivity assertion is made here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/- The degree API is stated on `relCurve`; install the product-spelled base-change instances
under that alias for every field used below. -/
noncomputable local instance instIsIntegralRelCurveTarget
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance instSmoothRelCurveTarget
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance instQuasiCompactRelCurveTarget
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance instFiniteH0RelCurveTarget
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance instFiniteH1RelCurveTarget
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L

/-! ## The honest twisted target -/

/-- If a degree-zero target becomes the honest Cech class `c` on an affine test, then its
chart twist is the unit image of `c` multiplied by the base-changed collapsed twist class. -/
theorem relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) :
    relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B)
        (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)
          (c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B)
            (chartTwistClass C m Z))) =
      chartTwist C m Z (overSpec k B)
        (pic0Map C g lam : picEt C (overSpec k B)) := by
  apply (picEtAffineEquiv C B).injective
  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt,
    chartTwist_eq_mul_thetaFamily_chartTwistClass]
  change PicEtAff.unit C B
      (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)
        (c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z))) =
    picEtAffineEquiv C B
      (picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) *
        thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C m Z) (overSpec k B))
  rw [map_mul (picEtAffineEquiv C B), hpic,
    picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt,
    picEtAffineEquiv_thetaFamily_eq_unit_relPicMk]
  exact map_mul ((PicEtAff.unit C B).comp (relPicMk C (overSpec k B))) _ _

/-- Datum-facing orientation of `relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist`: a datum presenting
the twisted class honestly presents the chart twist of the restricted target. -/
theorem chartTwist_picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_cechPicClass
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hD : D.cechPicClass =
      c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z)) :
    chartTwist C m Z (overSpec k B) (picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T)) =
      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B)
        (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) D.cechPicClass) := by
  rw [hD]
  exact (relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist lam g c hpic m Z).symm

/-! ## Uniform degree of the twisted target -/

variable {n : ℕ}

/-- The honest twisted class has the chart parameter as its degree after every field-valued
base change of the affine test. -/
theorem classDeg_twistedClass_eq
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z =
      (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra B K]
    [IsScalarTower k B K] :
    classDeg K (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B K)
      (c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B)
        (chartTwistClass C m Z))) = (n : ℤ) := by
  let t : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k B :=
    Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B K)
  have h := congrArg
    (fun mu : picEt C (overSpec k B) => degAt mu t)
    (relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist lam g c hpic m Z)
  rw [degAt_relPicToPicEt, relPicMap_mk, relPicDeg_relPicMk,
    degAt_chartTwist m Z (pic0Map C g lam).2 t] at h
  have ht : (C ◁ t).left = relCurveMap C B K := by
    refine congrArg (fun q : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k B => (C ◁ q).left) ?_
    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
  rw [ht] at h
  calc
    _ = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) -
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z := h
    _ = (n : ℤ) := by rw [hdeg]; ring

/-- Any Cech class identified with the honest twisted class has constant field degree equal to
the chart parameter.  This is the form consumed by datum and local-equation producers. -/
theorem classDeg_eq_of_eq_twistedClass
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
    (c d : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z =
      (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    (hd : d = c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B)
      (chartTwistClass C m Z))
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra B K]
    [IsScalarTower k B K] :
    classDeg K (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B K) d) = (n : ℤ) := by
  rw [hd]
  exact classDeg_twistedClass_eq lam g c hpic m Z hdeg K

/-! ## Widened Abel and chart-value consequences -/

/-- A widened family whose Picard class is the honest twisted target has Abel value equal to
the chart twist of the restricted degree-zero target. -/
theorem abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist_of_picClass_eq
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (F : DivFamZarAff C B n)
    (hF : F.picClass =
      c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z)) :
    abelDivAff' C n (overSpec k B)
        ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n B).symm F) =
      chartTwist C m Z (overSpec k B)
        (pic0Map C g lam : picEt C (overSpec k B)) := by
  calc
    abelDivAff' C n (overSpec k B)
        ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n B).symm F) =
        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B)
          (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) F.picClass) := by
      apply (picEtAffineEquiv C B).injective
      rw [picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff'_affineEquiv_symm F,
        abelDivAffPlus, picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt]
    _ = relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B)
          (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)
            (c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B)
              (chartTwistClass C m Z))) := by rw [hF]
    _ = chartTwist C m Z (overSpec k B)
          (pic0Map C g lam : picEt C (overSpec k B)) :=
      relPicToPicEt_twistedClass_eq_chartTwist lam g c hpic m Z

/-- The chart transformation sends a widened family with the honest twisted Picard class to
the restricted degree-zero target itself. -/
theorem chartValueAffTrans_app_eq_of_picClass_eq
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    (g : overSpec k B ⟶ T)
    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic)
    (hpic : picEtMap C g (lam : picEt C T) =
      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k B) (relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c))
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z =
      (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    (F : DivFamZarAff C B n)
    (hF : F.picClass =
      c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z)) :
    (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (overSpec k B))
        ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n B).symm F) =
      pic0Map C g lam := by
  exact chartValueAffTrans_app_eq_of_abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist
    m Z hdeg _ _
      (abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist_of_picClass_eq lam g c hpic m Z F hF)

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

-import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelKernel
-import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Proetale
-import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.LocallyBijective
-import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.RegularEpi
-
-/-!
-# The admissible Abel map after big-etale sheafification
-
-The big etale site of `Scheme.{u}` requires type-valued sheafification in `Type (u + 1)`.
-This module therefore applies `ULift` to the concrete admissible Abel transformation before
-sheafifying it. Subcanonicity identifies the sheafified source with the actual representable
-Yoneda sheaf of `divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C`.
-
-The target here is deliberately the etale sheafification of `pic0SigmaFunctor C`; identifying
-it with the original Picard functor is a separate mathematical step. No effective quotient or
-representability conclusion is asserted in this module.
--/
-
-set_option autoImplicit false
-
-universe u
-
-open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
-
-namespace AlgebraicGeometry
-
-/-! ## Subcanonicity of the big etale site -/
-
-/-- The big etale topology on schemes is subcanonical. -/
-instance Scheme.subcanonical_etaleTopology : Scheme.etaleTopology.{u}.Subcanonical :=
-  GrothendieckTopology.Subcanonical.of_le Scheme.etaleTopology_le_proetaleTopology
-
-variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
-variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
-variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
-
-/-! ## The sheafified concrete Abel map -/
-
-/-- The big-etale sheafification of the universe-raised Picard Sigma presheaf. -/
-noncomputable abbrev pic0SigmaEtaleSheafification :
-    Sheaf Scheme.etaleTopology.{u} (Type (u + 1)) :=
-  (presheafToSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).obj
-    (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1})
-
-/-- Subcanonicity identifies the universe-raised Yoneda sheaf of the admissible divisor
-representer with the sheafification of its underlying representable presheaf. -/
-noncomputable def admissibleAbelEtaleSourceIso :
-    Scheme.etaleTopology.uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj
-        (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left ≅
-      (presheafToSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).obj
-        (yoneda.obj (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1}) :=
-  (asIso ((sheafificationAdjunction Scheme.etaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).counit.app
-    (Scheme.etaleTopology.uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj
-      (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left))).symm
-
-/-- The concrete admissible Abel transformation as a morphism from its representable
-big-etale Yoneda source to the sheafification of the Picard Sigma presheaf. -/
-noncomputable def admissibleAbelEtaleSheafMap :
-    Scheme.etaleTopology.uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj
-        (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left ⟶
-      pic0SigmaEtaleSheafification C :=
-  (admissibleAbelEtaleSourceIso C).hom ≫
-    (presheafToSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).map
-      (Functor.whiskerRight (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C) uliftFunctor.{u + 1})
-
-end AlgebraicGeometry
